definitions.explanation: Books, especially in the context of libraries and institutional collections. A somewhat formal term for books.

examples.japanese: ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りた→借りる：00532_kariru⟧。
examples.english: I borrowed books from the library.
The library room is on the third floor.

examples.japanese: {図書|としょ}⟦{委員|いいん}→委員：01708_iin⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work as a library committee member.

examples.japanese: {図書|としょ}⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}りたい→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦のですが→のだ：noentry⟧。
examples.english: I'd like to make a library card.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{図書|としょ}⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧⟦には→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: Many new books were added to the school library room.

notes:
USAGE: {図書|としょ} is primarily used in compound words related to libraries and book collections. For 'book' in general, ⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧ is more common.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧ (library - public building)
- {図書|としょ}⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (library room - in schools)
- {図書|としょ}⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧ (library card)
- {図書|としょ}⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧ (book voucher/gift certificate)
- {図書|としょ}⟦{委員|いいん}→委員：01708_iin⟧ (library committee member)
- {図書|としょ}⟦{目録|もくろく}→目録：18979_mokuroku⟧ (book catalog)
- ⟦{参考|さんこう}→参考：02828_sankou⟧{図書|としょ} (reference books)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧ - book (everyday word)
- ⟦{書籍|しょせき}→書籍：04203_shoseki⟧ - books (formal)
- ⟦{書物|しょもつ}→書物：03683_shomotsu⟧ - books (literary/formal)
- ⟦{文献|ぶんけん}→文献：12885_bunken⟧ - literature, documents (academic)
